│   0 of 3 killed                                                                                                                          │

│  Pelts for the Tanners (Gather)                                                                                                          │
│   0 of 3 carried                                                                                                                         │
│   Pays 25 XP, 10 crowns and Cord Pendant                                                                                                 │
│   Bring back 3 wolf pelts from the wolves of the Downs. Tanner's Row pays by the pelt.                                                   │
